proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.title: Off-Configio word-range ownership clustering (generic)
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.problem: 18 unresolved devices share WORD_NOT_IN_ACTIVE_CONFIGIO — often contiguous word hundreds (1100s) suggesting foreign/remote/legacy map ownership.
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.proposal: Add a deterministic pre-AI cluster heuristic: group wildcard Machine_Name claims by word-hundreds + device family; if ZERO words in the cluster appear in active Configio AND peer machines in the same RUN claim overlapping ranges, emit ownership=FOREIGN_CANDIDATE / REMOTE_IO_CANDIDATE with cited peer evidence — still requiring engineer confirm before LOCAL map write.
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.does_not: Invent physical endpoints or Safety zone membership

proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.title: Nomenclature typo / OCR suspect gate
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.problem: ESPB1O looks like a typo of ESPB10/ESPB1 — currently treated as real Safety device.
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.proposal: Generic suspicious-identifier detector (O/0, I/1 confusable characters in ESPB/ESLS/MCR/PB families) → flag REVIEW with suggested alternates; never auto-rename.

proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.title: Module capacity vs proven-spare ledger split (already started)
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.problem: 128 unproven unused channels remain as occupancy — correct exclusion from resolution %, but engineers need a capacity view separate from field-device resolution.
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.proposal: Expose MODULE_CHANNEL_CAPACITY ledger in Hardware I/O: occupied / explicit-spare / unnamed-unproven. Keep unnamed-unproven out of PHYSICAL_DEVICE_RESOLUTION denominator.
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.does_not: Re-inflate resolution % by calling occupancy SPARE

proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.title: Safety evidence union ≠ active-controller Configio binding
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.problem: Many ESPB/ESLS appear in EStop.asc / safety_model evidence with words absent from active Configio — physical-world YES, ownership unresolved.
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.proposal: Split Safety discovery into (a) SAFETY_CANDIDATE inventory from EStop/Conveyor and (b) SAFETY_BOUND when PhysicalWordResolver proves module endpoint on the active controller. Candidate inventory remains visible for engineer zone assignment without blocking non-Safety PLC generation.
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.does_not: Auto-assign Safety zones or invent Safe_PI members

proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.title: Control-station PB semantic target without address invention
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.problem: PB6_JR / SS13P7 retain strong nomenclature (control station) but off-Configio words.
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.proposal: When nomenclature proves CONTROL_STATION_* , record likely Fortna Plus UDT member (CPx_CS.I.*) as semantic target while ownership stays REVIEW/FOREIGN until binding evidence exists — improves workbench clarity without fake LOCAL maps.
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.does_not: Write IO_MAP rows or L5X aliases without endpoint proof

proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.title: Cross-machine Configio range index for foreign proof
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.problem: FOREIGN today requires explicit Machine_Name ≠ active; wildcard N/A blocks proof.
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.proposal: Build a read-only index of all machines' Configio word ownership in the RUN. If word W is absent locally but present under Machine_Name=X in the same RUN, cite that as deterministic FOREIGN evidence for wildcard claims of W.
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.does_not: Guess when word is absent from ALL machines
proposed_generic_resolver_improvements.mscrenopick_observation: For MSCRENOPICK 1100s, peer Configio index finds NO owner machine — improvement still valuable generically, but would not auto-resolve this site cluster.
